name: River Development Agent Controlled Execution Audit Foundation
architecture: GENERATION III CONTROLLED EXECUTION AUDIT FOUNDATION
invariants: DEV-282 consumes only the exact DEV-281 controlled execution archive result contract.
DEV-282 denies audit establishment when the DEV-281 predecessor is malformed, untrusted, unready, unarchived, blocked, inconsistent, or missing required archive evidence.
DEV-282 creates deterministic audit data only.
DEV-282 does not execute or re-execute an operation.
DEV-282 does not retry execution.
DEV-282 does not invoke an executor.
DEV-282 does not persist lifecycle state.
DEV-282 preserves the exact approved execution scope.
DEV-282 preserves predecessor provenance and the complete execution/archive evidence chain.
DEV-282 does not expand execution scope.
DEV-282 does not create new execution authorization.
DEV-282 does not modify repository content.
DEV-282 does not delete repository content.
DEV-282 does not stage repository changes.
DEV-282 does not commit.
DEV-282 does not push.
DEV-282 does not deploy.
DEV-282 does not access secrets.
DEV-282 does not perform arbitrary shell execution.
DEV-282 does not perform network execution.
DEV-282 does not perform external side effects.
Rejected predecessor payloads release no trusted predecessor payload.
A future explicit controlled execution attestation boundary is required before downstream progression.
